name: LocalSend
title: LocalSend: free Pushbullet Pro alternative
hook: Pushbullet charges you forty bucks a year to send big files between your phone and computer. This app does it for free.

features.say: Send files and messages to nearby devices over your local network, no internet needed.
Everything is encrypted, and it works between Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android.

caption:
Pushbullet Pro charges $39.99/year to send big files between your phone and computer. LocalSend does it for free 📲

✅ Send files and messages to nearby devices, no internet needed
✅ Encrypted, with no middleman servers
✅ Works between Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android
✅ No subscription, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ Both devices need to be on the same local network (Wi-Fi). If a transfer doesn't connect, check your firewall and that your router's AP isolation is off. Pushbullet's $39.99/year is the Pro yearly plan (free Pushbullet caps files at 25 MB)

Comment "SEND" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
